_comment: Mutants that survive for a reason somebody established, so that a run's
output can be read as 'what changed' rather than 'what is there'.
An entry is a claim that this specific change cannot be observed. Do not
add one on inspection alone: apply the mutation by hand, watch the suite
stay green, and say in `reason` what makes it unobservable. A mutant that
is merely untested is not equivalent -- it is a missing test.
Everything not listed here is reported as new. That is accurate rather
than noisy: the classifications made in earlier rounds live in tp closure
reasons, which is exactly the place a later round cannot read them from.
Moving one here is what makes it durable.

survivors.reason: NextID keeps the highest id seen, so `n > highest` and `n >= highest` assign the same value: on equality the assignment writes back what is already held. Verified by hand on 2026-09-01 -- applied `>=`, `go test ./internal/finding` stayed green. The comment above the line says the same thing, and it predates this file.
